# Compute Tier

`Universe › Server Infrastructure › Compute Tier`

Where work actually executes. Pools are shaped by workload profile — synchronous, batch, streaming, accelerated — and packed by a scheduler.

## Components (13)

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [API Cluster](./api-cluster/) | Stateless request-serving nodes for synchronous API workloads. |
| [AI Cluster](./ai-cluster/) | Accelerator-backed nodes dedicated to inference and training. |
| [Batch Cluster](./batch-cluster/) | Scheduled, throughput-oriented jobs tolerant of preemption. |
| [Streaming Cluster](./streaming-cluster/) | Continuous stream processors with checkpointing and exactly-once semantics. |
| [GPU Cluster](./gpu-cluster/) | GPU pools with topology-aware scheduling and device partitioning. |
| [CPU Cluster](./cpu-cluster/) | General-purpose compute for services with no accelerator requirement. |
| [Worker Cluster](./worker-cluster/) | Queue-driven workers that drain asynchronous job backlogs. |
| [Background Services](./background-services/) | Long-running daemons — reconcilers, sweepers, and periodic tasks. |
| [Microservice Runtime](./microservice-runtime/) | The standard runtime contract every service ships against. |
| [Serverless Runtime](./serverless-runtime/) | Scale-to-zero functions for spiky, short-lived work. |
| [Edge Runtime](./edge-runtime/) | Constrained runtime executing at points of presence near the user. |
| [HPC Cluster](./hpc-cluster/) | Tightly coupled low-latency-interconnect nodes for simulation workloads. |
| [Compute Scheduler](./compute-scheduler/) | Bin-packs workloads across the tier by cost, locality, and priority. |
